notes.title: Update notes for v2023.10.15 - Leaderboards are go!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Happy Sunday!

This week's update sees the addition of leaderboards to Tonalities: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2265750/leaderboards/12012035/]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2265750/leaderboards/12012035/[/url]

Every time you complete an "Act" (a set of around 4 or 5 puzzles), your score will automatically uploaded to Steam so you can see how you compare with your friends (and how you compare with the rest of the world!) 

I've been through the game from start to finish to put in some challenging (in my opinion at least) scores to beat. Hopefully, I won't stay at number 1 for too long!

If you experience any problems or have any feedback on what you'd like to see added next, please let me know in the discussion forums: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2265750/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2265750/discussions/[/url]

Cheers,
Jared

notes.title: Update notes for v2023.10.01
notes.notes:
Releasing slightly ahead of schedule, here is the latest update for Tonalities.

v2023.10.01 is a content update, we're adding 5 new puzzles all based around the brand new "Mirror Block" mechanic. Please try it out and let us know your thoughts on this latest batch of puzzles.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2265750]Please share your feedback in the discussion forums[/url]

notes.title: Update notes for v2023.09.19
notes.notes:
[b]Quality of life updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to quickly reset levels by either pressing the space bar or by clicking the right mouse button.
[*]Added a trail to the ball to make it easier to line up future shots.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Ch-ch-ch-ch-changes bug to ensure it triggers.
[*]Updated the pause menu to make all main settings accessible in-game.
[*]Created a new layout for the level select page.
[/list]

[b]Behind-the-scenes updates:[/b]
Jared created a new build pipeline (doesn't affect you, but it makes my life easier!)

notes.title: Early Access release of Tonalities
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that the first 6 levels of Tonalities are now available on Steam Early Access! Please try out the game and let us know what you think in the discussion forums.

From now on, expect new updates and content to be dropped every 2 weeks. We are expecting to be in early access until early 2024 and will be prioritizing updates based on player feedback. So if there is anything you'd like adding, changing, removing, this is your chance to let us know.

Thank you for your support!

Jared
